videos.title: ScHoolboy Q - Floating (2019)
videos.description: Schoolboy Q's music video for "Floating" features a dizzying, dreamlike journey through the streets of Los Angeles, with distorted visuals and rapid camera movements capturing a surreal sense of disconnection. The video mirrors the song's hazy, laid-back vibe, immersing viewers in a trippy, out-of-body experience.
